AMEND, nonblocking. Codex independent audit by codex-pyscenedetect-admission against exact main 0b414b443e62cf4ee67a7f81e4846c2a8c13ab36.

CONFIRMED REUSABLE SEAMS
- core/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/core/surface.scala:94-106 and 156-232,307-324: WindowPlan plus stable SurfaceSequence traversal, span lookup, slicing, windows, and centered context.
- features/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/features/track.scala:5-36; window.scala:44-62,197-214; derivation.scala:114-178; sidecar.scala:39-59; boundary.scala:5-67: aligned tracks, declared missing-aware reducers and receipted derivations, sidecars, multiview boundary evidence, and typed forward/backward/return/simultaneous world-time transitions.
- acquire/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/proposal.scala:68-79; critic.scala:100-116; resolve.scala:44-54,250-319,357-416: proposal-only agents, typed critics, deterministic accepted/alternative/unresolved/rejected states, and append-only candidate history.
- document/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/document/compiler.scala:574-596 and 716-720: durable NarrativeCompilation with mention/coreference/projection/resolution/derivation-gap evidence and pure compiler authority.
- story/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/story/model.scala:14-31: one graph/hierarchy/trajectory/features/claims model, but concretely StorySource plus SurfaceAtlas.
- view/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/view/atlas.scala:306-325,382-425 and view/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/view/codex.scala:360-377: renderer-neutral VisualPrimitive/NarrativeScene and CodexFlow packets.

AMENDMENT TO THE INVENTORY
core/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/core/transcript.scala:28-69,121-123 already has checked millisecond AudioSpan, TranscriptTurn.audio, and turnAtAudio. This is only an optional text-turn overlay: no axis identity, timebase, edition, gaps, cross-clock relation, alternative wording lattice, or media evidence. It does not contradict the missing C1 substrate, but it must be named as an existing migration/conformance seam.

ABSENCE AND LIVE-CANDIDATE CHECK
An exact git grep over Scala/build sources at 0b414b found none of SourceBundle, PresentationAxis, MediaAtlas, EvidenceAnchor/EvidenceSupport, DialogueLattice/timed-token types, audiovisual ObservationTrack, media clock/mapping, worker schema, MovieModel/SourceSubstrate, FFmpeg, or PySceneDetect. Those names exist only in design/coordination records. The current pending Mote inventory has one movie candidate, cand-7MEX4N9K5PVNQS7C32XCWVNX3H at f203b783da349d705258fef8634becf3e1e5a554, and its sole path is docs/design/movie-component-admission-ledger.md. The active D2 work reserves only the plan and cumulative notes. All other pending code candidates are align, interview, parser-provider, or NFRD paths; none supplies movie substrate or runtime.

DISPOSITION
Treat the post as the implementation baseline after adding the AudioSpan/TranscriptTurn compatibility seam. C1 remains a portable provider-free substrate refactor with text and existing timed-transcript conformance. No runtime/package/media conclusion follows.
